title: Cloud Software Company for Sale in Pune, India
tagline: The business specializes in pump selection software and customized digital solutions for the pump industry. - Our business primarily focuses on a recurring revenue model through monthly and annual software subscriptions, supplemented by customization, implementation, and maintenance services. - We also provide software customization, data integration, multi-brand configuration, and related digital solutions to streamline business processes, improve efficiency, and support faster customer responses. - We aim to build long-term client relationships, grow predictable recurring revenue, and scale our software solutions across the industrial sector. - Registered as a Private Limited company with GST and MSME.
